20261122-chemistry-m2-2.material: Wen we put small electrolyte for inside water and use electricity break am (electrolysis), which one correctly match di gas wey dey comot for (-) electrode and (+) electrode with dia volume ratio?
20261122-chemistry-m2-2.thinking.0: Wen we put small electrolyte for
20261122-chemistry-m2-2.s.s1.prompt: Wen we put small electrolyte for inside water and use electricity break am (electrolysis), which one correctly match di gas wey dey comot for (-) electrode and (+) electrode with dia volume ratio?
20261122-chemistry-m2-2.s.s1.explain: Based on di electrolysis equation of water $2\text{H}_2\text{O}(l) \rightarrow 2\text{H}_2(g) + \text{O}_2(g)$, hydrogen gas go comot $2$ volumes for di (-) electrode wey reduction dey happen, and oxygen gas go comot $1$ volume for di (+) electrode wey oxidation dey happen.
20261122-chemistry-m2-2.s.s1.hint.0: Di chemical formula of water na H₂O (2 hydrogen atoms and 1 oxygen atom).
20261122-chemistry-m2-2.s.s1.o.o0: (-) electrode: hydrogen (H₂),  (+) electrode: oxygen (O₂),  volume ratio = 2 : 1
20261122-chemistry-m2-2.s.s1.o.o1: (-) electrode: oxygen (O₂),  (+) electrode: hydrogen (H₂),  volume ratio = 1 : 2
20261122-chemistry-m2-2.s.s1.o.o2: (-) electrode: hydrogen (H₂),  (+) electrode: chlorine (Cl₂),  volume ratio = 1 : 1
20261122-chemistry-m2-2.s.s1.o.o3: (-) electrode: water vapour,  (+) electrode: nitrogen,  volume ratio = 2 : 1
